title: Mixed: partial moves that stay general
goal: Part 1: first say only 'You don't need to stay late.' After Marcus's nudge ask 'Why do you think they call back?' and nothing else. Part 2: say 'Just write more down on your calls.' Do not give a specific step or a reason, even if Marcus asks more like what: answer 'I don't know, just be more careful.' Part 3: say 'Ask Nina for some tips on angry customers.' Do not say to do the calls together. When Marcus asks like just ask her what to say, say 'Yes, that's right.' When Marcus then offers 'Maybe Nina could sit in on them with me. Would that be okay?' say only 'Yes, that would be good.' with no timing.
must_avoid: A specific step on every call

examples: You don't need to stay late.
